name: Petr Svoboda
bio:
Petr Svoboda's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. After years in general HR, a chance encounter with a local racing team at a career fair sparked his interest. He was fascinated by the passion and dedication of the team members, and saw an opportunity to apply his skills in a unique and challenging environment.

At CRG Racing Team, Petr is known for his methodical approach to HR management. He prioritizes fairness, transparency, and building strong relationships with team members. He believes that a happy and supported team is a productive team. While not a technical expert, he understands the pressures of the racing world and strives to create a supportive environment where individuals can thrive. His calm demeanor and ability to resolve conflicts make him a valued member of the team.

What sets Petr apart is his commitment to continuous improvement. He's always looking for new ways to streamline HR processes, improve employee satisfaction, and ensure that CRG Racing Team attracts and retains top talent.

physical.description: Petr is a man of average height with a slightly stocky build, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always has a small notepad and pen on hand, even in meetings.
Enthusiastically participates in team-building activities, but is secretly terrible at them.
Often brings traditional Czech pastries to the office, especially Koláče.
